sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent on stress. Also, the work never mentions Nigilu or Kyawi (a full-text search for stress/accent found nothing): it is not among the 14 languages surveyed. The closest link is item (8) Bahinemo, p. 148: 'Capell (1962: 78) refers to a part of this language as Wogu, from the name of one of the villages, the one from which the word list used here was obtained' -- Wagu village is where Nigilu is reported (Dye & Dye 2012), but the list is explicitly Bahinemo. Nothing here can be attributed to Nigilu.
